question: Can you tell me which healthcare provider incurs the highest combined average costs for both outpatient and inpatient services in 2014?
sql:
SELECT 
  i.provider_id,
  i.provider_name,
  AVG(i.average_total_payments) AS avg_inpatient_cost,
  AVG(o.average_total_payments) AS avg_outpatient_cost,
  AVG(i.average_total_payments) + AVG(o.average_total_payments) AS combined_avg_cost
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2014` i
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_2014` o
  ON i.provider_id = o.provider_id
GROUP BY i.provider_id, i.provider_name
ORDER BY combined_avg_cost DESC
LIMIT 1
